title: Chapter 172 Transport Host
content:
Chapter 172 Transport Host

In addition to combat troops, the second batch of Zerg reinforcements to support the Naga tribe also needs a transport team. The Zerg needs to transport a batch of luck beads and some precious supplies from the Naga tribe.

The Naga tribe has limited preparation time, and the first batch of supplies for the Zerg must be mainly luck beads. Luck beads are precious and small, and a large number of luck beads do not take up much space.

The Naga tribe is most likely to carry a large number of luck beads with the army, which can be seen from their generous release of luck blessings and opening of large-scale luck formations on the battlefield.

Wu Qing decided to evolve a transport host to see how much carrying capacity it can have. If the carrying capacity of a transport host is large enough, then this matter will be very simple.

Wu Qing summoned a host, first upgraded the host to three stars, and then selected the extra abdominal sac evolution option of the three-star host. The resources were consumed, and the three-star host turned into a giant pupa on the spot.

The giant pupa kept wriggling and growing, and the amplitude was even more exaggerated than the evolution of the Zerg hydralisk into a stealth spider.

This change did not stop until a huge creature with a diameter of more than 30 meters floated in front of Wu Qing.

"Zizi!"

The sound of the giant pupa breaking and being absorbed sounded, and a giant host with a diameter of about 30 meters broke out of the pupa and absorbed all the giant pupa.

The round body with a diameter of more than 30 meters, thick and flexible tentacles, and a thick and hard defensive shell, this is the largest creature Wu Qing has seen since he came to this world.

Wu Qing checked it out. The transport host has the same other abilities as ordinary three-star hosts. The upgraded abdominal sac gives it more transport capabilities, a huge body, and increased defense capabilities and vitality accordingly.

Wu Qing came under the transport host to observe and test its abilities in person.

The transport host stretched out a tentacle to form a loading space entry ladder. Wu Qing could go up along the tentacle and enter the transport host's abdominal sac loading space.

Wu Qing went up along the tentacles, and the transport host also demonstrated to him how to use multiple tentacles to form various login channels, and how to directly roll up the target with the tentacles and send it in. There are various login methods to meet the needs of fast login in different environments.

Wu Qing entered the transport host's abdominal sac loading space through the hatch at the bottom of the transport host. Inside was a huge spherical space with a diameter of nearly 30 meters and a height of nearly 30 meters.

In addition to the outer defensive shell of the transport host, almost all of it is loading space.

The transport host also demonstrated to Wu Qing the ability of the loading space to quickly adjust the internal structure according to needs. The loading space can be a giant space, or it can quickly generate partitions to divide the giant space into multiple spaces of different sizes.

The amount and size of the loading space can be adjusted at will, which is very practical and convenient.

According to transportation needs, the environment of the loading space can also be adjusted, such as adjusting it to an environment suitable for Zerg, an environment suitable for human beings like Wu Qing, and various environments such as high temperature, high pressure, refrigeration, and vacuum.

As long as there is energy resource support, the loading space of the transport host can adjust the loading space at will according to the type of transportation.

Finally, Wu Qing tested the other abilities of the transport host, which was no different from other three-star hosts, and even had enhanced defense capabilities.

High-speed flight, ultra-long-range detection perception, anti-stealth, strong mental power, the talent of reducing one's own presence, strong defense capabilities and strong loading capabilities, etc., these abilities of the transport host, plus the security guarantee that the queen can come at any time, give it the capital to run rampant alone.

If loaded with powerful combat troops of the Zerg, the Zerg can have ultra-long-range strategic strike capabilities!

Performing various special tasks is even more of a piece of cake!

After Wu Qing fully understood the capabilities of the transport host, he was very satisfied and decided to send this transport host to the Naga territory tomorrow, without even sending escort troops.

With the transport host, many things will be more convenient to do.

…

After arranging the second batch of troops to support the Naga tribe, Wu Qing came to the Zerg clones and Zerg guards who had returned to the Zerg territory, and next to them were the Zerg war horses they rode.

With the support of stronger Zerg biotechnology, after the optimization of the Queen, the consumption of Zerg Zergmen has been reduced to the same level as that of Zerg Hydralisks, consuming 75 energy, 25 gas and a larva to hatch a Zergmen.

And the hatched Zergmen come with a set of evolvable biological colonization suits, which can be regarded as its shell weapon.

Affected by the humanoid form, the combat power of Zergmen on the battlefield is not as good as that of Hydralisks, but their abilities are more balanced and their comprehensive abilities are stronger.

The resource consumption and comprehensive abilities of Zergmen are already very good, and they are a choice suitable for this world.

Because the Zerg has been upgraded through the mother nest, the combat power of the Zerg ground forces has been comprehensively upgraded and improved. Zergmen, like Zerg Hydralisks and Zerglings, will be improved, which makes their combat power very considerable.

If necessary, Zergmen can be hatched in large numbers and become another major main force of the Zerg in this world.

The Zerg Zergmen's troop template has been optimized, and the resources required to upgrade Wu Qing's Zergmen clones and ten Zergmen guards have also been reduced accordingly.

Wu Qing used resources to upgrade the strength of the specially enhanced insect man clone to three stars, selected a insect man guard with the most accumulated luck to upgrade to three stars, and upgraded the rest of the insect man guards to two stars.

A three-star strongman leading nine two-star guards is a strong force, worthy of Wu Qing's current status.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

With Wu Qing's ability to control the Zerg clones, they are able to move freely on the battlefield.

...

Zerg horses have also been optimized, consuming 50 energy and a larva to hatch two Zerg horses, which is the same consumption as Zerg puppies.

The Zerg horse is as strong as the Zerg puppy, but its main function is to serve as a mount for humanoid races, and its combat power is not as good as that of the Zerg puppy.

It is comparable to the Zerg puppy in terms of long-distance running, speed, endurance, and defense, and even has some abilities that are better. It is a very excellent mount.

Zerg horses do not consume gas resources and are spiritual, but they are not intelligent creatures, which just fits its position as a mount, and the cheap price is suitable for large-scale hatching.

With such Zerg horses, the human army led by Wu Cong in Daxia does not need to go to great lengths to tame wild horses as mounts.

To successfully tame a wild horse into an excellent warhorse, not to mention the time, manpower and material resources spent, the Zerg energy coins consumed alone may be more than 25 energy.

Wu Qing upgraded the mounts of the Zerg clone and the Zerg guards to the corresponding star level. With a good horse and a combat power multiplier, the combat power of the Zerg clone and the Zerg guards will be doubled.

…

Wu Qing is so concerned about the optimization of Zerg and Zerg warhorses because some of his ideas need to be supported by Zerg and Zerg warhorses.

In his mutual exchanges with the goblin merchant Gong Zhe, Wu Qing has a clearer understanding of the vastness of this world. This world must be larger than the current system-affiliated world. How big it is, it is estimated that not many people in this world can clearly explain it.

According to Gong Zhe, the area where the Zerg is located is just the most remote corner at the foot of the Endless Mountains, which happens to be at a point where the local camp and the evil god camp are fighting. Otherwise, it is a place that no one cares about.

The forces of the Tengu and Naga tribes here are just extensions of the countless tentacles of the two tribes. Losing them all will not have any impact on the two tribes.

The evil god camp that is facing them is also a bunch of small characters. For example, the bear goblin tribe actually has a complete range of arms, and the demon tribe has far more than three arms. The strength of these two tribes is very strong, far from the current strength.

In Gong Zhe's view, the scale of the territory here is simply a child's play. The truly powerful territories of the local camps, the protection range of the lord of a territory, at least covers thousands of miles, and at most covers tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of miles. There are also territories where the lord's protection range is boundless.

The population in these territories is even more incalculable, and unimaginable amounts of luck are generated every moment.

Of course, these are all what Gong Zhe heard from the knowledgeable tribesmen, and he has not seen the real situation with his own eyes.

He just followed the arrangements of the tribe and needed to pass through this remote area of small merchants. Many things are still far away from him, and he needs to keep working hard to get closer.

That's why he desperately seized the opportunity of discovering the Zerg Energy Coin, striving to succeed in crossing the level as soon as possible and see a wider world.

After Wu Qing learned about these situations, he had a better understanding of the true strength of the big clans in this world.

Wu Qing's idea of relying on the Zerg and using the identity of the human race to expand his influence in this world became stronger and stronger.

The human race is not only the core race in the local camp, but also a foreign strong race in the evil god camp. If the human race is used well, there will be many unexpected benefits in the future.

That's why Wu Qing is so concerned about the optimization of Zerg and Zerg warhorses, and must optimize them to the point where they can be mass-produced.

The front-line battlefield of the camp confrontation must of course be dominated by Zerg. Even if Zerg is equipped with Zerg warhorses, their performance on the battlefield may not be better than the current Zerg troops.

In the ground melee on the battlefield, no troop is as useful as the Zerg puppy.

For long-range attacks, the Zerg Hydralisk is already perfect.

These Zerg and Zerg warhorses are not used on the front battlefield of the Zerg.

But in the vast territory of the native camp behind the front line of the camp confrontation, these Zerg people and Zerg war horses have a place to use their skills.

Wu Qing has a very detailed understanding of the human wanderers through the witch. The Zerg people can completely enter the hinterland of the native camp in the mode of human wanderers and implement Wu Qing's various plans.

Wu Qing has tasted the sweetness of continuously harvesting a large amount of luck through ways other than war. Countless ideas flashed through his mind. He told these ideas to the Queen of the Worm one by one, asking the Queen of the Worm to improve some feasible plans from a realistic perspective to enhance the popularity and influence of the Zerg, Daxia Territory and other forces related to Wu Qing.

As long as a small number of people in this world know about the forces related to Wu Qing and have a certain reputation and influence, the system's Qi resources will no longer be in short supply.
